source: LED Connection NightShade wall pack LC-FWP-WS-3CCT: supplier wall pack spec sheet and installation instruction (tools/specs/sources/LC-FWP-WS-3CCT/fcw-spec-install.pdf, pages 4-7). Never printed.
inbox: Wall pack (upper half and lamp base)
Mounts over a recessed junction box

warning: The complete installation must be done by a qualified electrician.
Be sure the power supply is turned off before installation, and switch off the mains before any work.
Use the standard working voltage, 120-277V AC, 50/60Hz. Do not exceed it.
Keep the external power wires protected against water, dust and shock.
Make sure every wire connection is in good condition, with no leakage.
common.electrical: Supply the wall pack with 120-277V AC, as on its label. It dims with 0-10V: purple DIM+, gray DIM-.
common.grounding: Connect the green wire to the ground of the supply, in accordance with the NEC and local codes.
before: Ensure that the supply power is shut off.
Unpack the wall pack and check that nothing is damaged or missing.
The wall pack mounts over a recessed (embedded) junction box in the wall.

steps.title: Unscrew the screws with a screwdriver and remove the upper half of the fixture from the lamp base.
Unscrew the cover of the entry hole on the lamp base and remove it.
Punch the mounting holes on the lamp base that match the embedded junction box.
Pass the input wires from the junction box through the waterproof pad and then through the lamp base.
Lock the lamp base on the junction box with screws.
Connect the wires: black to line (L), white to neutral (N), green to ground; purple to DIM+ and gray to DIM- for 0-10V dimming. Put the connections into the junction box.
Set the wattage and CCT on the internal DIP switches. Wattage: up 45W, centre 60W (default), down 75W. CCT: up 3000K, centre 4000K (default), down 5000K.
Put the upper half back and lock the fixture with its screws. Installation completed.

record_note: Anything not as designed (height, setting, junction box): write it in the pin's note.
